title: Murmur ContextPacket v1
description: What the Android side hands to the prompt renderer after capture, filtering, ranking and privacy redaction (docs/ml/CONTEXT_AND_PROMPT.md §4-§6). All strings are already redacted. The renderer (prompts/render.py) applies sanitising and the character budget; producers should still respect the per-field limits below to avoid wasted work.

captured_at_ms.description: Epoch ms of the accessibility snapshot. Not rendered.

category.description: Style key into prompts/tones/tones.v1.json (after user overrides).

hint.description: getHintText() (API 26+). Not rendered in v1; used to derive kind.

input_type_variation.description: Name of the android.text.InputType variation of the focused field, e.g. TYPE_TEXT_VARIATION_EMAIL_ADDRESS.

before_cursor.description: Field text before getTextSelectionStart(); renderer keeps the last 300 chars. Empty when the field shows its hint (isShowingHintText()).

after_cursor.description: Field text after getTextSelectionEnd(); renderer keeps the first 100 chars.

title.description: Chat partner / thread subject / document title (toolbar title, getPaneTitle(), window title).

messages.description: Most recent visible messages, oldest first. Renderer keeps the last 3, 160 chars each.

terms.description: Candidate names/terms ranked by the device (§4.5). Renderer keeps the top 40 / 400 chars by score.

matched_transcript.description: True if fuzzy/transliteration match to a transcript span (strongest signal).

screen_snippets.description: Short high-value lines that are not messages (e.g. a page heading, a document line near the cursor). Renderer keeps 3 x 120 chars.

asr.description: ISO 639-1 language of the transcript: ASR language id (Whisper/Qwen3-ASR) or the model's fixed language (GigaAM, T-one => ru).

field.description: Script-based guess from before_cursor. Not rendered in v1.

ui.description: Dominant language of screen text. Not rendered in v1.

dictionary.description: Entries of the user's personal dictionary that fuzzy-match the transcript (not the whole dictionary).

level.description: full: everything; terms_only: app line + names/terms + dictionary (no messages, no field text, no snippets); app_only: app line only; none: post-processing still runs but with an empty context.

reason.description: Why the level was lowered (secure_window, denylisted_app, password_field, user_setting). Not rendered; logged locally.
